column1: # Leaf 8: DeltaBench heights, JTable with a TableRowSorter (column 1 descending), 2026-10-20, JDK 21.0.9 + --patch-module java.desktop, SerialGC, -Xmx1500m, shared machine (other agents running).

# One row per JVM run and metric; each value is the median of 7 rounds, in ms. run A = first run (09:54), B1-B3 and C1-C3 stock then m3, D1-D2 m3 then stock, E = m3 with -XX:+PrintCompilation on a quieter machine.

# set_1000_heights: setRowHeight on 1,000 spread rows; frame_queries_1000: 1,000 rowAtPoint + getCellRect pairs (sparse store); set_every_height: setRowHeight on every row in random order (dense above 4,096 entries); dense_queries: 1,000 pairs with every row custom; dense_steady: the same after 200,000 more queries.

# Medians over the 10^6 runs: set_1000_heights stock 3.37 / m3 0.78; frame_queries_1000 stock 2.30 / m3 1.32; set_every_height stock 2,561 / m3 2,338; dense_queries stock 1.54 / m3 4.34; dense_steady stock 1.35 / m3 2.09.
# Probe (scratch DenseProbe: same model, sorter and sparse phase, then 6 rounds of 100,000 pairs, JVM order alternated, 3 runs per flag), ms per 1,000 pairs: flag on 0.94-2.70, flag off 1.00-3.29.
# Allocation per 1,000 query pairs: 0.056 MB on both sides (the Point and Rectangle per pair that the bench and getCellRect create); per setRowHeight: 0.
